title: Validity Witness (Fork omega): bind the SPRT integrity class to the verified address
hypothesis: Closes Ghost #5. The engine H_t = HASH(Z+S+W+t) is the GEOMETRIC identity and does NOT encode the EXP-309 SPRT validity class, so a LOD_RELAXED state (a predicate bypassed at distance / level-of-detail) hashes identically to a FULL_VALID state of the same geometry -- a coarsened view could claim full integrity (integrity laundering). The hole is CONTAINED (Gamma_309, the only LOD_RELAXED producer, is not reachable from the dentatus.* facade; api.observe only mints FULL_VALID) but not CLOSED. A validity witness binds the class to the address: FULL_VALID -> H_t (unchanged, backward compatible); LOD_RELAXED -> HASH(H_t + class + pv) (distinct); INVALID -> None. A relaxed state can then never share an address with a full-valid one. Engine FROZEN (no _compute_H change).

mechanism.containment_bound: Gamma_309 not in dentatus.core exports; api.observe has no validity_class reference
mechanism.backward_compat: FULL_VALID address == plain H_t -> every existing Series-500 H_verified unchanged

engine_scope: NO engine edits. game/observability/integrity.py uses dentatus.core only. state/operators/confluence/validity FROZEN.
assertions_fork_A: [2] confirm hole: engine H_t COLLIDES across validity classes (identical geometry -> identical H_t)
[3] FULL_VALID -> verified_address == H_t (backward compatible with EXP-602)
[4] LOD_RELAXED -> verified_address != H_t AND != FULL_VALID address (distinct, records bypass)
[7] containment: Gamma_309 not reachable from dentatus.* facade; api.observe has no validity_class ref
[8] no regression: Series-500 api.observe stays FULL_VALID -> H_verified bit-unchanged
[9] integrity_witness records the class + geometric H + bound address (auditable)
assertions_fork_B: [2] binding property holds in both orientations (FULL_VALID addr == H_t)
